description: There are multiple phones with a telephoto camera priced in India under Rs. 50,000. You can consider the Nothing Phone (4a), Motorola Edge 70 Pro+, Tecno Camon 50 Ultra, Realme 16 Pro+, and Oppo Reno 15 5G. All phones are equipped with a 50-megapixel telephoto camera on the back. The Nothing Phone (4a) is one of the newer additions to the list of phones priced under Rs. 50,000 that feature a telephoto camera. The handset is powered by Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset. The Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ is one of the most powerful phones in this list. The smartphone is equipped with an octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 8500 Extreme chipset.
title: Best Phones With Telephoto Cameras Under Rs. 40,000: Nothing Phone (4a), Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ and More

description: Silicon-carbon technology sure packs plenty of benefits over traditional lithium-ion batteries. The technology has evolved over the years, since it was first announced by Huawei in 2023. While it isn’t perfect, we take a closer look at its pros and cons.
title: Silicon-Carbon vs Lithium-Ion Batteries: What's the Difference and Which Is Better?

description: Pebble Qore 2 is the latest addition to the company's screen-less fitness tracker lineup. Priced at Rs. 3,799, the affordable tracker gets some things right, but falters on a few basic functionalities. The Pebble Qore 2 under-records most activity markers, like calories burned, steps taken, and the time the user was active. However, it does manage to solve the problem of distractions. The screen-less design pairs well with most attire and doesn't stick out like a sore thumb. You can easily wear the fitness tracker for long hours.
title: Pebble Qore 2 Review: Incredible Battery Life, But the Tracking Misses the Mark

description: Apple will host the 'Pro and Tell' launch event next week, Apple's Senior Vice President of Worldwide Marketing, Greg Joswiak, announced on Monday. Separately, YouTube creator and tech reviewer Marques Brownlee (@MKBHD) shared an image of the media invite that Apple sent to creators and media houses. The media invite confirms that Apple will host the ‘Pro and Tell’ event on October 28. The event is scheduled to commence at 10:00 am PT (10:30 pm IST). Further, the media invite mentions that the ‘Pro and Tell’ event will take place in Los Angeles. “Please join us in person for a special Apple Experience,” the invite reads. Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman says that the animation shows a finger touching the screen to draw the Apple logo, hinting at the new category Apple is expected to enter.
title: Apple ‘Pro and Tell’ Event Set for Next Week; First MacBook With Touchscreen, New iPad Mini and More Expected to Launch

description: Samsung Galaxy F70 5G is now available for purchase in India. The handset is currently available for purchase in India via Flipkart. The e-commerce giant is offering an instant discount of Rs. 2,000 with the HDFC Bank credit card. Alternatively, customers can get a cashback of Rs. 1,000 with a Flipkart Axis Bank credit card. The company is also allowing buyers to exchange their old device for up to Rs. 15,900. Moreover, the new Samsung Galaxy F70 5G is offered in two colour options, namely Bold Black and Vivid Violet. Both RAM and storage configurations are available in the two shades. The handset is equipped with a 6.7-inch Full-HD+ Infinity-U sAMOLED display.
title: Samsung Galaxy F70 5G With 5,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Camera Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: The OnePlus 16 and iQOO 16 are flagship smartphones powered by Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset. They are available in multiple RAM and storage configurations in China. Both phones run Android 17-based software. The OnePlus handset has ColorOS 17, while the iQOO phone has OriginOS 7. Here is a comparison of the OnePlus 16 and iQOO 16 prices and specifications.
title: OnePlus 16 vs iQOO 16: Price and Specifications Compared

description: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE was recently launched in India with a notable price hike, now available at a starting price of Rs. 79,999. However, the smartphone still sticks to its key 'Fan Edition' character of offering a near-flagship user experience. The phone does not offer any notable upgrades over the Samsung Galaxy S25 FE. It gets the same battery, camera configuration, display, and charging support. However, it has been refreshed with last year's Exynos 2500 chipset, which powers the Galaxy S25 series. It also gets a redesigned rear camera module, similar to the Galaxy S26.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE Review: Near-Flagship Specs, But at What Cost?

description: BenQ India Managing Director Rajeev Singh explains why Rs 50,000 to 70,000  is a good budget for a home projector, what buyers can expect at this price, and how newer models are making big-screen entertainment easier at home.
title: Want A Big-Screen Experience At Home This Diwali? BenQ CEO Reveals The ideal Projector Budget

description: Oppo F35 Pro 5G was recently launched in India, marking 10 years of the Oppo F series in India. Priced at Rs. 45,999, the new smartphone is more expensive than its predecessor, with the base variant offering less RAM. The Oppo F35 Pro 5G looks identical to the Oppo F33 Pro 5G, which was launched earlier this year. However, it gets a significant display and chipset upgrade over the Oppo F33 Pro 5G. The Oppo F35 Pro 5G is also 0.1mm thicker than its predecessor, but the marginal difference is barely noticeable. Yet, the focus of the new F series phone remains selfies, which is still quite good.
title: Oppo F35 Pro 5G Review: An 8,000mAh Battery and a Lot to Like
